headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of July 21, 2026, the portfolio set has achieved an average return of 18.38%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 10.43%. This results in an average alpha of 7.95%, indicating that the portfolios are not only rising in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered an impressive return of 49.35%, contributing a dollar change of $493.52. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned 11.37%, highlighting the variability in performance across the portfolio set. This outperformance relative to SPY is particularly noteworthy during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience against broader market fluctuations. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
